negative_findings.description: Searched in Ukrainian for a consolidated, machine-readable NBU register of applied enforcement measures ('перелік застосованих заходів впливу'). Found only recurring narrative monthly news releases (mostly AML/FX-framed) and no evidence of a structured downloadable dataset or a consumer-protection-specific sanctions list.
negative_findings.result_summary: Enforcement data for this cell appears to exist only as prose news items plus, indirectly, as decisions appealed into the court register.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any time series of conduct-related sanctions will have to be built by NLP over news text and by cross-matching appeals in ЄДРСР, not by downloading a register; that changes the collection design and cost.

negative_findings.description: https://bank.gov.ua/ua/consumer-protection returned HTTP 403 Forbidden to a programmatic fetch during this run, while the same content appears live in search results and a mirror path new.bank.gov.ua/ua/consumer-protection is indexed.
negative_findings.result_summary: Hypothesis: bot-defended but live. Not recorded as dead.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection for the highest-priority publisher in this cell needs a browser-grade fetcher or the new.bank.gov.ua path; a naive crawler would silently record the regulator as unavailable.

negative_findings.description: Searched in Ukrainian for an operating Ukrainian financial ombudsman publishing dispute outcomes. Found only the long-pending legislative model (bill on the institution of financial ombudsman, registered 2018, No. 8055) and World Bank recommendations; no evidence of a live ombudsman body publishing decisions as of this run.
negative_findings.result_summary: No ADR-body decision stream exists for Ukraine comparable to a FOS-style publisher.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Removes what would normally be the richest dispute-outcome source in this cell and concentrates all signal in NBU complaint reports plus the court register; also makes the ombudsman bill itself a high-value watch item for a future source.

negative_findings.description: The English seed query on NBU consumer protection/enforcement returned almost exclusively US regulators (CFPB, FDIC, OCC) and no Ukrainian primary sources.
negative_findings.result_summary: English-language discovery is near-useless for this cell; Ukrainian terms carried essentially all the yield.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Confirms that ongoing monitoring must be built on Ukrainian keyword sets; an English-only pipeline would produce a false-empty result for Ukraine.

coverage_gaps.description: Two landing URLs were inferred rather than directly observed: the Supreme Court practice-review index and the NBU consumer-protection report index. Individual PDFs under them were observed in search results, but the index paths themselves were not fetched in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have the deterministic verification pass resolve the index URLs and, if they 404, discover the correct index by crawling from supreme.court.gov.ua and new.bank.gov.ua roots.

coverage_gaps.description: Only aggregated PDF complaint statistics were found; no open-data (CSV/API) release of NBU complaint counts by institution was located, and data.gov.ua was not searched in this run.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search data.gov.ua and the NBU statistics/open-data section in Ukrainian for 'звернення споживачів' datasets; if absent, plan PDF table extraction as the permanent method.

coverage_gaps.description: Administrative-court practice specifically on banks/PSPs challenging NBU enforcement measures (a direct read on where supervision is legally fragile) was not isolated; the commercial-court digest search returned only generic reviews.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run targeted ЄДРСР queries with the NBU as respondent ('відповідач: Національний банк України' + 'захід впливу' / 'штраф') across administrative and commercial courts, and check the Supreme Court administrative cassation digests.

coverage_gaps.description: The Deposit Guarantee Fund (Фонд гарантування вкладів фізичних осіб) complaint/depositor-dispute stream and the Business Ombudsman Council were not searched in this run, though both publish dispute-outcome material touching banks.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add Ukrainian-language sweeps for 'Фонд гарантування вкладів звернення вкладників' and 'Рада бізнес-омбудсмена банк скарга' in the next pass.

coverage_gaps.description: The cell's 'consultations' topic was only reached indirectly (rule-change announcements). A dedicated NBU public-consultation / draft-regulation page for conduct rules was not confirmed, partly because bank.gov.ua blocked fetching.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and verify the NBU 'громадське обговорення проєктів регуляторних актів' page via a browser-grade fetch and register it as a separate source with deadline extraction.

brief: For Ukraine, consumer-protection supervision signal is concentrated in two structurally separate publishers: the NBU (a conduct-supervision rulebook on zakon.rada, a quarterly complaint-statistics PDF series, and a monthly enforcement-measures news release) and the judiciary (the free full-text ЄДРСР register, Supreme Court legal positions and cassation practice digests), with Opendatabot as the practical API layer over the latter. There is no functioning financial ombudsman publishing dispute outcomes — the bill has been pending since 2018 — so complaint and litigation data carry the entire early-warning load, and the АМКУ misleading-advertising decisions form a second, commonly overlooked enforcement channel against banks. The main collection obstacles are bot protection on bank.gov.ua (403 on plain fetch, treated as live-but-defended) and the absence of any structured, machine-readable enforcement or complaint dataset, which forces PDF/table and news-text extraction. English-language discovery was effectively empty for this cell; all yield came from Ukrainian terms such as 'заходи впливу', 'звернення споживачів', 'несанкціоноване списання' and 'обмежені платіжні послуги'.
